newsitem.title: USA: Rexall Sundown offer priced at $27.25/shr.
newsitem.headline: Rexall Sundown offer priced at $27.25/shr.

text.p: Rexall Sundown Inc said Tuesday its secondary public offering of four million shares has been priced at $27.25 per share and has been declared effective.
The company is offering two million shares, and certain shareholders are offering the rest.

The company said it intends to use its estimated net proceeds of $51.8 million primarily to acquire complementary products, product lines or businesses, to provide working capital, and for general corporate purposes.
Rexall Sundown develops, manufactures, markets and sells vitamins, nutritional supplements and consumer health products.
